Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs framing the face. Sharp, narrow golden-yellow eyes with a cold expression. Apparent age of a young adult with refined maturity. Slender and lean build. Wears a high-collared white and gold regal robe with layered fabric and ornate embroidery. Features a pair of massive, majestic white feathered wings extending from the back.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
